events.title: Berkeley Bird Festival
events.venue: David Brower Center and East Bay birding sites
events.why: Once-a-year birding festival with guided morning field trips and an afternoon fair of talks, exhibits and kids' activities at the Brower Center.

events.title: Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festival (54th annual)
events.venue: Main Street, downtown Half Moon Bay
events.why: The coast's signature fall street fair with giant pumpkins, pie-eating contests, live music and a costume parade; final day of the two-day run.

events.title: Harding Carnival & Pumpkin Patch
events.venue: Harding Park and Clubhouse, 7115 C Street
events.why: Elementary school PTA carnival with games, live music and magic, food and a pumpkin patch; a true neighborhood event tourists never see.

events.title: Palo Alto Art Center Fall Family Day
events.why: Free afternoon of hands-on art-making tied to the current exhibitions, ten minutes from Menlo Park and well suited to tweens.

events.title: Shipyard Open Studios Fall 2026
events.why: Twice-a-year chance to wander 130 working artist studios in the old naval shipyard, with free admission and parking.

events.title: Sunday Streets Excelsior
events.why: Car-free neighborhood block party with bike riding, performances and activity zones; the last Sunday Streets of the 2026 season.

events.title: Children's Fairyland Monsters' Ball
events.why: Adults-only (21+) Halloween night with a DJ and cocktails inside the storybook park; a rare grown-up take on a kids' landmark.

events.title: Goblins' BOOtacular
events.why: Small-town Marin Halloween street party with downtown trick-or-treating and activities on a Friday evening.

events.title: Halloween Haunted Hangar at Hiller Aviation Museum
events.why: The museum's hangar becomes a not-too-scary haunted walkthrough with Halloween activities, included with admission, October 23 through 31.

events.title: Pleasanton Harvest Festival Original Art & Craft Show
events.why: Three-day indoor fair of roughly 500 handmade-craft vendors with entertainment and food, running October 23 through 25 with $5 admission on Sunday.

events.title: Witches & Warlocks Wine Stroll
events.why: Adults-only (21+) costumed wine tasting through downtown Los Altos shops; a once-a-year neighborhood event.

events.title: Boos and Brews on B Street
events.why: Downtown San Mateo Halloween street party mixing kids' trick-or-treating with a beer garden for parents.

events.title: Cupertino Monster Mash
events.why: Evening Halloween party with games, crafts and a haunted maze run by the city; ticketed and listed in The Almanac's roundup.

events.title: FOG Diwali Festival of Lights
events.why: One of the Bay Area's largest Diwali melas with cultural performances, food stalls and a fireworks finale.

events.title: Foster City Halloween Festival
events.venue: Foster City Community Center, 650 Shell Blvd.
events.why: City-run festival with carnival games, crafts and costume contests; pre-registration is required and it usually sells out.

events.title: Leap Sandcastle Classic (44th annual)
events.why: Architecture firms and school teams build huge themed sand sculptures on Ocean Beach; a once-a-year spectacle kids love to watch.

events.title: Lit Crawl SF 2026
events.venue: Mission District bars, cafes and shops
events.why: Litquake's free roaming literary festival with 250+ authors reading in bars, laundromats and bookstores; adult-leaning though some venues welcome all ages.

events.title: Menlo Park Halloween Hoopla Parade and Carnival
events.venue: Fremont Park and Santa Cruz Avenue
events.why: Your hometown costume parade down Santa Cruz Avenue with merchant trick-or-treating and a carnival in Fremont Park.

events.title: Mountain View Monster Bash
events.why: Free fall festival with stilt walkers, a bike circus, inflatables, live performances and a Treat Trail; details in The Almanac's Halloween roundup.

events.title: Northern California Renaissance Faire Halloween Fantasy Weekend
events.why: Closing weekend of the Ren Faire, themed for Halloween with costumes encouraged, jousting and artisan villages; runs Saturday and Sunday.

events.title: Paint-A-Plane at Hiller Aviation Museum
events.why: Kids get to paint a real Cessna Cardinal and explore open cockpits, included with museum admission.

events.title: Randall Museum Family Halloween Day
events.why: Free Halloween crafts, science activities and live animals at the Corona Heights museum.

events.title: San Jose Diwali Carnival
events.why: Free downtown Diwali celebration with Bollywood music, dance performances and Indian food vendors running into the evening.

events.title: Symphonic Spooktacular with Symphony San Jose
events.why: Full orchestra playing heroes-and-villains film and Halloween scores, a good first symphony outing for kids; also Sunday October 25 at 2:30 pm.

events.title: Teen Halloween Roller Derby
events.why: A free Halloween roller-skating event aimed specifically at teens and tweens, a rare age-appropriate option for the 12 to 14 crowd.

events.title: Witches and Wizards on Water Paddle
events.why: Costumed witches and wizards paddle kayaks and boards around the Alameda shoreline; free to watch from shore, with kayak rentals or a $10 launch fee to join.

events.title: Downtown Burlingame Halloween Costume Bar Crawl
events.why: Adults-only (21+) costume crawl through Burlingame Avenue bars; listed in The Almanac's Halloween roundup.

events.title: Menlo Park Pumpkin Splash
events.venue: Burgess Pool and Belle Haven Pool
events.why: Swim out to pick a pumpkin from a floating patch at the city pools, then decorate it; ticket includes pumpkin, goody bag and swim time.

events.title: OMCA Día de los Muertos Community Celebration (32nd annual)
events.why: One of the region's biggest Day of the Dead celebrations with community altars, Aztec dancers, mariachi and craft stations.

events.title: Pillar Point Halloween Witches Paddle
events.why: Costumed paddlers fill the harbor in the morning, followed by a trunk-or-treat at 2 pm; a coastside tradition locals know about.

events.title: UC Botanical Garden Animal Day
events.why: Annual day of live-animal encounters and wildlife organizations stationed throughout the garden, included with regular admission.

events.title: World of Dumplings Festival
events.why: Free-entry food festival with dumpling vendors from a dozen cuisines plus demos at the Ferry Building.

events.title: Boo Bash Redwood City
events.venue: Chan Zuckerberg Community Space, 801 Jefferson Ave.
events.why: Free weeknight Halloween party with shadow theater, a slime lab, banjo sing-along and costume parade; entry by reserved time slot.

events.title: Howl-ooo-ween at Lindsay Wildlife Experience
events.why: Evening Halloween event at the wildlife rehab museum with animal encounters, crafts and trick-or-treat stations.

events.title: Belmont Boo Bash
events.why: Free evening Halloween festival in Belmont's Twin Pines Park with games, crafts and trick-or-treating.

events.title: Menlo Park Trunk-or-Treat
events.why: City-run trunk-or-treat with decorated car trunks and free candy bags, a short walk from home on a Wednesday afternoon.
